text:
maya: heads up — deploy-bot just finished postdeploy smoke for rollout/2026-04-shadow-toggle, seeing a short p95 spike on embed-route when shadowing ~30% traffic :thinking_face:
deploy-bot: POSTDEPLOY SMOKE REPORT for rollout/2026-04-shadow-toggle
```
status: partial-pass
checks: [health-checks, synth-probes, kv-warmup]
embed-route.p95: baseline=120ms -> observed=285ms (30m window)
error-rate: 0.2% (slight increase, mostly 429s)
note: spike correlates with shadow-toggle at 30% traffic
```
jon: did we see any backend OOMs or host-level pressure?
paul: checked hosts in eu-west1, memory and cpu look stable, no OOM logs. mostly queueing at inference-proxy layer.
lina: synth-probes show larger variance for long-context prompts, tail grows with concurrency. sample: `curl -X POST /gen -d '{"prompt":"<long>", "tokens":1024}'` failing p95.
sre-oncall: adding trace links — http://traces/internal/trace/abc123 (embedding route spikes at proxy handoff) :mag:
maya: thanks. can we quickly toggle shadow off while we triage? need to avoid user-facing regressions if this cascades during peak.
jon: +1. what about pinning the model variant back to v2-quant while we debug? current rollout is to model v3-int8-shadow.
paul: pin would require a quick config change, low-risk. but shadow traffic off first reduces load and gives cleaner signal.
lina: agree — toggle shadow off, keep canary at current production. I'll pause the shadow toggle in the rollout config now.
deploy-bot: ACTION: shadow traffic toggled to 0% for rollout/2026-04-shadow-toggle by lina at 1965432165
maya: confirm we start re-evaluating metrics after another 5m window.
sre-oncall: rolling-window p95 now trending down: 180ms -> 130ms in 3m. error-rate back to baseline 0.05%.
jon: good. let's keep the rollout paused and annotate the release notes: "paused shadow-toggle due to p95 variance on long-context embed route; reverting shadow traffic to 0% while we investigate proxy queuing".
paul: added a short postmortem checklist to the release ticket (ENGREL-1129) and linked the smoke report.
lina: triage plan: 1) reproduce with synthetic long-context batch locally, 2) check proxy connection pool settings, 3) run a targeted canary with 5% direct traffic to v3-int8 without shadowing to isolate model perf.
maya: timeline: if canary 5% looks stable in 30m, we can resume a controlled shadow at 5% and monitor. if not, rollback to v2-quant for next deploy cycle.
deploy-bot: NOTE: update release window: paused at 1965432165, resume decision due by 1965433965 (4h window).
jon: quick ask — can SRE adjust the proxy timeout from 10s -> 12s for the canary test? might reduce head-of-line retries while we debug.
sre-oncall: can do for canary namespace only. will schedule a config flip before the 5% canary.
maya: thanks all. Please drop any logs or oddities into ENGREL-1129 thread. I'll prepare a small blurb for product/marketing so they don't see user impact telemetry and panic. :thumbsup:
paul: noted. i'll also attach the synthetic payloads we used so devex can reproduce.
maya: closing this thread for now. followups in ENGREL-1129.
